Subject: Re: Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thanks for reaching out. I’ve reviewed your questions regarding the contract, and I’m happy to discuss both points.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for net-30. Let’s schedule a brief call to discuss this further and see if we can find a middle ground that works for both of us. As for the non-compete clause, I agree that we should review it to ensure it is equitable and reasonable. We can definitely adjust the scope or duration to better suit your needs.

Please let me know what time works best for you to connect later this week.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams

Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically oysters and mussels.
